title: Total Video Editing Genius
description:
The McCord List Media Network | Faith-Forward, Female-Founded, Nationally Syndicated



-----



**Employment type: Starting at PT, but will quickly grow if this is the right fit 

**Hours:**  8-3pm PST



-----



## Read this part first



We are not looking for someone who “does some editing.” We are looking for a total crusher.



Someone who opens Premiere Pro and disappears into the work. Someone who turns raw footage into broadcast-ready episodes without being chased, watches the full cut before anyone has to ask, and treats a missed deadline like a personal offense. If you need hand-holding, this is not your role. If you have been waiting for a place that moves as fast as you do, keep reading.



The McCord List Media Network is a nationally syndicated media operation reaching more than 90 million households across Roku, Amazon Prime, Samsung TV Plus, and Tubi. We produce The McCord List Today plus a growing roster of client shows, all from a real LED soundstage in Manhattan Beach. We are faith-led, purpose-driven, and obsessed with editorial polish. Every frame we publish carries the brand.



This is a high-volume, high-standards seat. The right person will thrive on it.



-----



## What you will own



You are the engine room of our content. Your job is to take raw footage and turn it into polished, on-brand, broadcast-ready episodes and the social clips that fuel our reach.



Week to week, you will:



- Pull and organize weekly raw footage from our Google Drive client folders by filming date, and confirm intro, outro, branding, and guest assets are in place before you cut

- Edit full-length episodes in Adobe Premiere Pro: clean cuts, balanced audio, color and LUTs applied, awkward host 
nts and BTS removed, branded intro and outro graphics in place

- Export final episodes in high resolution (both our 22-minute and 40 to 48 minute formats) and file them correctly under Final Episodes

- Cut individual interview segments for each guest

- Generate 30 to 35 social clips per episode in Opus Clip Pro, then review every clip for accuracy, brand tone, captions, logo, and framing before it ships

- Maintain clean, standardized folder structure in Google Drive so nothing ever gets lost

- Upload approved episodes to U Screen with complete, accurate metadata pulled from the Content Sheet (title, guests, description, SEO, category)

- Keep the task sheet and dashboard current on every episode, and flag missing assets or technical issues immediately

- Move episodes through our review chain: edit, submit to Nicole, apply notes, host review, final revisions, approved, posted

- Jump on special projects when leadership calls: sizzle reels, highlight cuts, promo overlays, urgent social turnarounds



-----



## The numbers (this is the filter)



We say crusher and we mean it. Here is the pace:



- **8 to 10 episodes per week** combined across The McCord List Today and client shows

- Roughly **3 episodes** for The McCord List Today and **7** for client shows

- Every edit delivered within **24 to 48 hours** of raw footage delivery

- **30 to 35 social clips** generated and reviewed per episode



If those numbers excite you instead of scaring you, we should talk.



-----



## The quality bar



We do not ship anything that does not look and sound like us. Every deliverable is checked against our QA standard before it goes out:



- Clean, balanced audio throughout

- Bumpers in place (first, middle, end) and the correct intro and outro sizzle

- Names and titles spelled correctly

- Nothing distracting in the background and no stray BTS left in

- Correct brand logo, every time

- Social clips with accurate captions, the brand logo, and the host or guest centered in frame

- Consistent file naming: `Episode [#] - Guest Name - Final.mp4`



You will be the last line of defense on quality. That is a responsibility we hand to people who take it seriously.



-----



## You are a fit if you



- Live inside Adobe Premiere Pro and edit fast without sacrificing polish

- Have a real eye for pacing, color, and audio, and you notice the small things other editors miss

- Are fluent (or fast to learn) in Opus Clip, U Screen, Envato Elements, and Google Drive based workflows

- Manage your own queue, hit deadlines without reminders, and communicate proactively when something is off

- Understand brand consistency and protect it like it is your name on the export

- Have published work for streaming, broadcast, or high-volume digital content (please send your reel)

- Can troubleshoot audio issues and care about presenting work that crushes the game



## Bonus points if you



- Have worked in a fast-paced media network, agency, or studio environment

- Know your way around motion graphics and templated branded packages

- Care about purpose-driven, faith-forward content and want your work to mean something



-----



## Why this seat



You will be part of a media network that is scaling, not stalling. Your edits go out to tens of millions of households, not into a folder no one opens. You will work alongside a tight, driven team that values craft, speed, and faith. And you will see your fingerprints on a brand that is building something rare in this industry.



We are looking for one person who wants to crush it here for the long run.



-----



## How to apply



Send the following:



1. Your reel or a link to 2 to 3 recent full edits you are proud of

1. A short note on the highest volume you have ever sustained and how you kept quality high

1. The fastest you have ever turned a polished episode from raw footage



No generic cover letters. Show us the work.



-----



*The McCord List Media Network is a division of LaunchPreneur, Inc.*

title: Junior Video Editor — DTC/UGC Ads
description:
# Junior Video Editor — DTC/UGC Ads (Part-Time, Remote, Philippines)



## About us

We're a US-based performance marketing agency running paid social for DTC brands across supplements, beauty, real estate, and lifestyle. We test and ship new ad variants every week, and we need a fast, reliable editor in the production pipeline.



This is a junior role. We're not expecting a stacked portfolio or strategic creative chops — we're looking for someone fast, coachable, and hungry to get better while editing real ads running on real ad budgets.



## The role

You'll work under our senior editor, executing on briefs and turning around variants fast:



- Cutting hook variants — we give you the body, you swap and test 3–5 hooks

- Resizing and reformatting ads for placements (9:16, 1:1, 4:5)

- Captions (burned-in, branded styling), basic sound design, music

- Sourcing simple B-roll from stock libraries when the brief calls for it

- Following our editing style guide — caption styling, pacing benchmarks, brand colors

- Light AI generation work as you ramp — we'll train you on the tools (Higgsfield, Kling, Google Flow)

- Async updates via Slack/Loom — what's done, what's stuck, what needs review



This is creative production execution, not creative direction. You're not d
 what gets made — you're making it, fast and clean.



## Requirements

- 6 months to 2 years editing experience, ideally short-form social or UGC content

- Portfolio showing clean editing — solid pacing, clean audio, decent captions. Spec work and personal projects count

- Fast in CapCut, Premiere, or DaVinci — pick one, be quick in it

- Vertical-first editing fluency (Reels/TikTok/Stories)

- Fast turnaround — briefs Monday morning means first drafts Tuesday EOD

- Coachable — you absorb feedback and apply it next round without getting defensive

- Reliable async communicator — you don't go dark, you flag blockers early

- Detail-oriented — you catch your own typos, audio glitches, and export issues before delivery



## Bonus (not required)

- You've played with Higgsfield, Kling, Runway, Google Flow, Sora, or CapCut AI features — even as a hobby

- You've used stock libraries before (Storyblocks, Pexels, Artgrid)

- You watch a lot of ads and have opinions about them

- Motion graphics basics (After Effects or CapCut templates)



## What this role is NOT

- Not a creative strategist role — concepts come from us

- Not a heavy AI generation role yet — you'll learn it over time

- Not low-volume — expect 10+ variants a week once ramped



## Logistics

- **Type:** Independent contractor, ongoing

- **Compensation:** $250 USD/month

- **Hours:** 20 hrs/week, flexible scheduling, some PST overlap preferred

- **Location:** Remote, Philippines

- **Tools:** We cover AI tool subscriptions and stock library access

- **Growth:** Clear path to more volume, senior responsibilities, and higher pay as you prove out — strong performers move up fast



## How to apply

Send all of the following — incomplete applications get skipped:



1. **Portfolio link** — Drive folder, Vimeo, or personal site. Short-form social work preferred. No portfolio = automatic skip

2. **3 ads from other brands you think are well-edited** — link each and tell us in 1–2 sentences what you like about the editing

3. **Which editing software you use and how long you've used it**

4. **Have you touched any AI video tools?** — yes/no. If yes, which and what you made. "Not yet" is a fine answer

5. **Availability and start date**



## Process

1. Application review and shortlist

2. 15–20 min video call with a quick portfolio walkthrough — you'll screen-share 1–2 pieces and walk us through your edit decisions

3. Offer



-----



Template cover letters get filtered. Tell us something real.

title: Client Success Representative
description:
Employee Retention Benefits (ERB) is seeking a high-performing, operations-minded Client Success Representative to serve as the primary point of contact for clients. Post-Interaction Administration: Draft and deploy clear
 recaps to clients immediately following calls, explicitly detailing ownership, next steps, and deadlines. 



Expectation Management: Set internal calendar alerts and reminders to proactively follow up with clients, ensuring they never have to reach out to ERB for an update.

Process Optimization: Refine and update

Knowledge Transfers: Brief internal management or newly assigned tea
mbers on historical account pain points, communication preferences, and general account health.

Change Management Re-framing: Guide clients through structural shifts, system updates, or carrier migrations by reframing administrative updates as high-value enhancements. 



Churn Intervention: Detect early warning signs of client dissatisfaction—such as communication drop-offs or frequent complaints—and deploy targeted retention strategies. 



Offboarding & Reporting: When cancellation is unavoidable, manage the exit process professionally to preserve the company’s reputation while capturing accurate feedback for executive reporting. 



5. Daily Execution & Team Participation 

End-of-Day (EOD) Accountability: Submit detailed EOD summaries highlighting completed work, metrics, and pending tasks. 



Meeting Engagement: Actively participate in team alignments, training sessions, and weekly L10 meetings. 



Knowledge Base Utilization: Organize and reference training materials within Shared Teams folders and knowledge bases to maintain strict alignment with established SOPs. 



Required Skills & Competencies 



1. Client Service & Professional Capabilities 

2. Regulated Industry Experience: Prior experience in insurance, financial services, or a highly regulated, policy-driven industry is strongly preferred. 

3. Process Adherence: Ability to consistently follow detailed protocols, multi-step procedures, and established SOPs. 

4. Communication Mastery: Professional phone etiquette and exceptional written skills, with the ability to articulate complex policy rules simply. 

5. High Output Capacity: Ability to remain calm, highly organized, and accurate while managing high-volume
 and call queues. 



Technical Platform Proficiency 



1. Candidates must be highly proficient, or demonstrate the rapid capacity to become proficient, in the ERB operational tech stack: 

2. CRM & Tools: GHL, VoIP, etc 

3. Collaboration & Productivity: Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365, OneDrive, and internal reporting tools 

4. Insurance Knowledge (Preferred but not required) 

5. Familiarity with group insurance products, claims processes, and standard insurance terminology. 

6. Ability to easily read, interpret, and explain policy certificates, brochures, and carrier documentation.

Core Value : Performance Standard & Behaviors

Attention to Detail : Accurately logs calls, updates records immediately, and verifies client information on every interaction.

description:
Position Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented and dependable Accounting Clerk to join our finance team. In this role, you will be responsible for day-to-day accounts payable, accounts receivable, and account reconciliation activities. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working with numbers, takes pride in accuracy, and is looking to grow within a supportive organization. As you gain experience, this role has real potential to expand in scope and responsibility.



Key Responsibilities

Accounts Payable

• Process vendor invoices and match to purchase orders or receipts

• Prepare and execute check runs, ACH payments, and wire transfers

• Maintain vendor records and respond to payment inquiries

• Ensure invoices are coded to the correct GL accounts

Accounts Receivable

• Generate and send customer invoices in a timely manner

• Apply incoming payments and reconcile customer accounts

• Follow up on outstanding balances and assist with collections outreach

• Maintain accurate records of all AR activity

Reconciliations & General Accounting

• Perform monthly bank and credit card reconciliations

• Assist with month-end close tasks and journal entries

• Identify and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner

• Support the team with reporting, filing, and other accounting tasks as needed



Qualifications

Required

• High school diploma or equivalent; associate’s degree in Accounting or Business preferred

• 2+ years of experience in an accounting, bookkeeping, or finance support role

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and familiarity with accounting software (QuickBooks, Sage, or similar)

• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines

• Effective written and verbal communication skills

Preferred

• Experience with ERP or accounting systems in a business environment

• Working knowledge of basic GAAP principles

• Experience with month-end close processes



Growth & Development

We believe in promoting from within. As you build experience and demonstrate your capabilities, this role can evolve to include greater responsibility in financial reporting, process improvement, and team leadership. We will work with you to define a growth path that aligns with your goals.

title: Data Engineer – Platform Focus
description:
Role Summary 



We are looking for a hands-on Data & AI Platform Infrastructure Engineer to build, secure, automate, and operate the infrastructure that supports our reporting, analytics, and AI initiatives. 



This is not primarily an analytics engineering or dashboard-development role. The core need is an engineer who can take ownership of the platform work required to make our data and AI environment secure, reliable, auditable, and scalable: identity and access integration, Snowflake administration and security, network and connectivity controls, data integrations and pipelines, monitoring and operational automation, and controlled implementation of approved AI capabilities. 



Because we operate in a healthcare environment, this role requires disciplined security practices, careful handling of sensitive data, strong documentation, and the ability to turn compliance requirements into practical technical safeguards. The successful candidate will use approved AI tools as a force multiplier to research, design, implement, troubleshoot, document, and automate work - while verifying outputs and maintaining security and privacy controls. 



Why This Role Exists 



Our data and AI platform is expanding, and platform infrastructure must keep pace. This role will reduce reliance on a single internal technical owner by establishing repeatable, documented, secure operations and taking day-to-day responsibility for technical implementation and maintenance. 



The person in this role will help ensure that the right people and services have the right access, that integrations and pipelines run reliably, that platform changes are auditable, and that new AI or data services are evaluated and implemented responsibly. 



Key Responsibilities 



1. Identity, Access, and Snowflake Security 



•  Design, implement, and maintain Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) integration with Snowflake, including SSO and automated user/group provisioning where appropriate. 



•  Implement and maintain group-based role assignment, least-privilege RBAC, service-user access, key-pair authentication, warehouse access, onboarding, offboarding, and periodic access reviews. 



•  Maintain a clear role hierarchy and privilege model that separates administration, transformation, reporting, automation, and sensitive-data access. 



•  Configure and maintain masking policies, row-access controls, tags/classification, secure views, or related Snowflake governance controls as required. 



•  Produce access documentation and audit evidence showing who can access sensitive data and why. 



2. Network Security, Platform Configuration, and Operations 



•  Configure, test, and maintain Snowflake network rules and network policies, IP allowlists, integration connectivity, authentication controls, and related security settings. 



•  Troubleshoot failed logins, blocked network connections, broken integrations, authentication problems, role/privilege issues, and platform operational failures. 



•  Establish repeatable deployment and change-management procedures for security and infrastructure configuration. 



•  Configure operational monitoring, alerts, cost/resource controls, runbooks, and maintenance procedures for the platform. 



•  Support security reviews, audit requests, i
 investigation, remediation tracking, and evidence collection. 



3. Data Integrations, ETL/ELT, and Reliability 



•  Configure, maintain, and monitor data ingestion and integration pipelines into Snowflake, including existing and new vendor/system integrations. 



•  Evaluate integration options, authentication methods, data exposure, logging, failure handling, retry behavior, and operational support requirements. 



•  Build or maintain scripts and automations for pipeline monitoring, validation, alerting, recovery, auditing, and recurring platform administration.

s

title: Meta Ads Tracking & Funnel Optimization Specialist
description:
PLEASE complete your application form below.

***ONLY applicants who complete this form will be considered!!*** 




 





We're looking for a technical Meta Ads specialist who can help us fix and optimize our tracking, attribution, and funnel measurement systems.



**The Problem We're Trying to Solve:**

Our current Meta setup is not accurately tracking conversions.



For example, Meta recently reported 12 booked calls when only 2 calls were actually booked.



We believe there are issues with our tracking architecture, custom conversions, event setup, and funnel measurement. We need someone who can identify what's wrong, fix it properly, and ensure Meta is optimizing toward the correct actions.



If you've diagnosed and repaired tracking issues like this before, we'd love to hear from you.





**What You'll Be Doing:**

**Phase 1: Audit & Fix**

- Audit our Meta Pixel implementation

- Review and improve custom conversions

- Verify event tracking accuracy

- Identify duplicate or incorrect event firing

- Review funnel attribution and reporting

- Ensure Meta is optimizing toward the correct conversion events



**Phase 2: Improve & Scale**

- Improve conversion tracking across the funnel

- Optimize attribution accuracy

- Support Meta Ads performance improvements

- Assist with Google Ads tracking when needed

- Recommend improvements to funnel measurement and reporting



**Our Funnel Includes:**

- Landing Page Visits

- Quiz Funnel Progression

- Quiz Completion

- Call Booking Page Visits

- Booked Calls

- Payments



You should be comfortable mapping and validating each step of a funnel and ensuring conversion events are firing correctly.





**Required Experience:**

You should have hands-on experience with:

- Meta Ads Manager

- Meta Pixel

- Custom Conversions

- Conversion Tracking

- Funnel Analytics

- Event Troubleshooting



**Strongly Preferred:**

- Google Tag Manager (GTM)

- Conversions API (CAPI)

- Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

- Google Ads



**You Might Be a Good Fit If You Can Answer Questions Like:**

- Why is Meta reporting conversions that never happened?

- How do you verify which event is triggering a conversion?

- How do you determine whether events are firing too early?

- How do you troubleshoot discrepancies between Meta and actual booked appointments?

- How would you structure tracking for a multi-step funnel?

- Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills

- Able to clearly explain technical findings to non-technical tea
mbers

title: Paralegal/ Legal Assistant — Nonprofit & Tax-Exempt Organizations (US Law Firm | Fully Remote)
description:
Bay Legal, PC is a California law firm launching a dedicated nonprofit and tax-exempt organizations practice, and we are hiring our first senior paralegal to own it operationally from day one. This is not an assistant role. You will run nonprofit formations end-to-end, manage a growing compliance calendar, and serve as the primary client contact for this practice area, all under direct attorney supervision.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



-> NONPROFIT FORMATION (PRIMARY, FROM DAY ONE)



- Manage California nonprofit formation matters start to finish: public benefit, mutual benefit, and religious corporations

- Prepare and file Articles of Incorporation, Statements of Information, and FTB exemption applications (Forms 3500/3500A)

- Prepare Attorney General Registry initial registrations (Form CT-1) with all required founding documents

- Draft bylaws, board consents, conflict-of-interest policies, and governance documents from firm templates

- Prepare IRS Form 1023 and 1023-EZ packages including financial projections and activity narratives

- Coordinate EIN applications and post-formation compliance setup



-> ONGOING COMPLIANCE



- Own the recurring compliance calendar across the firm's nonprofit client portfolio

- Prepare and file annual RRF-1 and CT-TR-1 with the California Attorney General

- Coordinate IRS Form 990, 990-EZ, 990-N, and California Form 199 timing with client CPAs

- Monitor and address charitable solicitation registration requirements

- Maintain client governance documents and escalate lapses or reinstatement needs



-> CLIENT AND MATTER MANAGEMENT



- Serve as day-to-day client contact for formations and compliance matters

- Manage matter timelines, IRS determination-letter tracking, and client status communications

- Maintain matter records in Clio with strong tickler discipline



-> GROWTH PATH



Within 6 to 12 months, your scope expands to IRS procedural work: Form 1023 inquiry responses, automatic-revocation reinstatements, Form 990 reasonable-cause letters, and AG deficiency responses. Year two brings support for charitable estate planning matters and the firm's broader tax law practice launch. Enrolled Agent credential pursuit is supported if desired.



-> REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Minimum 3 years of paralegal experience, at least 1 focused on US exempt organizations, nonprofit formation, or tax-exempt practice at a US law firm

- Demonstrated experience preparing IRS Form 1023 and 1023-EZ applications including narrative drafting

- Direct experience with California Secretary of State, Franchise Tax Board, and Attorney General Registry filings (CT-1, RRF-1, SI-100, Forms 3500/3500A)

- Working knowledge of IRC Section 501(c)(3), public charity vs. private foundation classification under Section 509(a), and - California nonprofit corporation law

- Fluency with AI-assisted drafting tools (Claude, Perplexity, ChatGPT, or similar) with strong judgment about verification and output quality - this is a required qualification

- Excellent written English for drafting IRS narratives, client communications, and attorney-signed correspondence

- Proficiency with Clio and Lawmatics or comparable platforms

- Reliable remote setup with dedicated workspace and secure internet connection



-> PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Prior experience at a recognized California exempt-organizations firm

- Bilingual English/Spanish

- Enrolled Agent credential or active pursuit



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, you must send your application directly to 
 with the subject line: Paralegal - Nonprofit & Tax-Exempt Organizations



Applications submitted outside of this process will not be reviewed.



Please include the following in your
:



- Your resume or CV

- A cover letter highlighting your specific exempt-organizations experience, including the types of formations and filings you have handled, the firms or organizations you supported, and any IRS Form 1023 or California AG/FTB filings you have worked on directly

- Your monthly expected salary in USD

- Two writing samples redacted as needed (ideally one Form 1023 narrative and one client communication or memo)



We only review applications that follow these instructions. If your
 does not include all of the above, it will not move forward.

title: Senior Business Systems Specialist (Client Services)
description:
We are a US-based Managed Service Provider (MSP) seeking a high-level Senior Business Systems Specialist to help us build, lead, and scale our Software Solutions department.



This is a unique, multi-disciplinary role designed for a strategic thinker who sits at the intersection of Finance, Business Operations, AI, and Technology. We aren't just looking for an implementer; we are looking for a partner in growth. You will work directly with leadership to build out our service offerings, meet with potential clients to architect solutions, and eventually help us recruit and mentor the team that will execute your vision. If you have a deep understanding of Dynamics 365, a passion for Power BI, expertise in AI-driven automation, and the business acumen to solve complex operational problems, we want to hear from you.



Key Responsibilities

*Practice Development & Strategy

- Partner with leadership to define and build out our Software Solutions Department services, specifically defining our "go-to-market" strategy for AI, automation, and system integration.

- Evaluate, vet, and select cutting-edge AI tools, LLMs, and integration patterns (such as iPaaS, custom APIs, and Microsoft Copilot Studio) that can be productized and scaled for our client base.

- Develop standardized implementation methodologies, project templates, and integration/automation best practices for our delivering team.



*Presales, Client Advisory & Solution Selling

- Join leadership in high-level discovery meetings with prospective clients to identify operational pain points, inefficiency, and manual bottlenecks.

- Articulate the value of AI-driven automation and system integration, acting as the technical authority to "sell" these solutions and demonstrate substantial ROI to non-technical business leaders.

- Translate complex business requirements into high-impact "Proof of Concepts" (POCs), design blueprints, and comprehensive technical scopes.

- Lead the technical scoping, estimation, and pricing of projects, ensuring Scopes of Work (SOWs) are technically feasible, accurate, profitable, and highly achievable.



*Senior Implementation & Delivery

- Act as the lead consultant and chief architect for high-value Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and AI/Automation implementations.

- Design and deploy complex system integrations (APIs, ETL processes, middleware) to ensure seamless, real-time data flows across disparate applications in the client's tech stack.

- Architect advanced Power BI reporting suites and data models that provide clients with real-time visibility into their financial, operational, and automated workflow health.

- Oversee complex data migrations and governance, ensuring utmost data integrity and security across all customer platforms.



*Team Building & Mentorship

- Lead, and mentor a growing team of Power Platform Analysts and AI & Automation Solutions Consultants.

- Help define the roles, technical certifications, and skill matrices needed as we scale the Software Solutions practice.

- Provide deep technical mentorship and "over-the-shoulder" code and design reviews to ensure high-quality, scalable delivery across all client projects.



*Operational & Financial Consulting

- Use your understanding of business operations and finance to advise clients on process improvements, heavily leveraging AI and automation for workflows like automated billing, smart inventory management, and automated financial consolidation.

- Ensure all automated workflows, integrations, and system configurations align with GAAP/audit requirements and support long-term compliance and enterprise scalability.



Required Qualifications

* Experience: 7–10+ years in business systems consulting, systems integration, solution architecture, or IT leadership. Prior Managed Service Provider (MSP) or Professional Services consulting experience is highly preferred.

* Business & Finance Acumen: A strong, native understanding of core business operations and accounting principles (P&L, Cash Flow, AP/AR, and operational workflows).

* Dynamics 365 & Power Platform Mastery: Proven track record of architecting and implementing complex Dynamics 365 (F&O, Business Central, or CE) environments, Power Apps, and complex Power Automate flows.

* AI & Automation Expertise: Direct experience architecting and implementing AI solutions (e.g., custom LLM integrations, Microsoft Copilot, Azure OpenAI, OCR/Document Processing AI, or RPA).

* Integration Experience: Strong knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, iPaaS solutions (like Make, Workato, or Zapier), and ETL pipelines to connect disparate cloud software suite ecosystems.

* Presales & Solutions Advisory: Proven experience in client-facing consulting roles, including scoping, estimating, and presenting solutions directly to C-suite stakeholders to secure new business.

* Leadership Mindset: A strong desire to move beyond "doing the work" into building a practice, leading a team, and scaling an organization.



Preferred (Nice to Have)

* Professional accounting background (CPA, CMA) or deep experience configuring ERP financial modules.

* Microsoft certifications (e.g., Power Platform Solution Architect, Dynamics 365 Functional Consultant, or Azure AI Engineer).

* Previous experience in a "Founding" or "Lead" role within a fast-growing technical practice or startup department.



What Success Looks Like in This Role

* Phase 1: You are successfully co-leading sales meetings, closing new projects, and delivering high-value implementations.

* Phase 2: You have established a repeatable "playbook" for our business systems offerings and project delivery.

* Phase 3: You are leading a small, high-performing team of specialists, allowing you to focus more on strategy, high-level architecture, and practice growth.



Why Join Us?

We believe in creating an environment where our tea
mbers can thrive both professionally and personally. Here’s what we offer:

* Career Growth: Paid certifications, training, and structured onboarding to help you advance your skills.

* Attractive Compensation: Competitive salary, performance-based incentives (monthly profit share and end-of-year bonus), and 13th-month pay.

* Health & Wellness: Monthly healthcare allowance to support your well-being.

* Work-Life Balance: 100% remote work with company-provided equipment.

Supportive Culture: Be part of a forward-thinking team that values collaboration, innovation, and having fun while doing great work.



What Sets Us Apart?

* Performance-Based Rewards: Monthly profit sharing and bonuses for high-performing tea
mbers.

* Continuous Learning: We invest in your growth with paid certifications and training.

* Collaborative Environment: Work with a team that values your input and supports your success.

* Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of remote work while contributing to impactful projects.



How to Apply:

If you’re ready to take your career to the next level as a Senior Business Systems Specialist, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now and join a team that’s passionate about technology, growth, and delivering exceptional service.

title: Real Estate Video Editor
description:
Role Overview: Full Time Position | $4.50/hr room for negotiation | 9am-5pm EST



We are looking for a world class Video Editor to lead the post-production for our rapidly growing real estate YouTube channel. You won’t just be cutting clips; you will be responsible for crafting 10-20 minute "Masterclass" style relocation guides, home tours, and market updates designed to turn viewers into leads.



You must be an expert in retention based editing, knowing exactly when to use B-roll, zoom cuts, and sound effects to keep a viewer engaged for 15+ minutes. You will also be responsible for "mining" our long form content to create high impact, viral style Shorts/Reels.



Key Responsibilities

1. Long Form Mastery: Edit 3 high quality long form videos (10–20 mins) per week. This includes color grading, audio leveling (cleaning up "wind" or "echo" from field recordings), and advanced storytelling.

2. Short Form Distribution: Extract and edit a minimum of 5 engaging Shorts/TikToks per week. These must feature "Alex Hormozi style" captions, dynamic zooms, and high energy pacing.

3. Engagement First Editing: Implement "Pattern Interrupts" (B-roll, text overlays, sound design) every 5–10 seconds to maintain high Average View Duration (AVD).

4. Green Screen Integration: Seamlessly integrate Will's talking head footage with property B-roll, Google Earth maps, and market data graphics.

5. Asset Management: Sourcing high quality stock footage, music, and sound effects that match our "Authentic, grounded, yet premium" brand voice.



Technical Requirements

1. Software: Expert level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve. Experience with After Effects for custom motion graphics is a major plus.

2. Short Form Tools: Mastery of CapCut or similar for fast paced social media editing.

3. AI Integration: Familiarity with AI tools (Descript/Opus Pro/RunwayML) to maximize efficiency.

4. Real Estate Intuition: Ability to distinguish between "boring house footage" and "lifestyle B-roll" that sells the neighborhood, not just the kitchen.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Your success in this role will be measured by:

1. Average View Duration (AVD): Can you keep people watching past the 50% mark?

2. Click Through Rate (CTR) Collaboration: Working with our Digital Marketing Director to ensure the "hook" of the video matches the promise of the thumbnail.

3. Inbound Leads: Quality editing that builds trust and prompts viewers to click the "Contact Us" links.



Who You Are

1. You are a Storyteller first and an editor second.

2. You are obsessed with YouTube analytics and understand why a viewer clicks away.

3. You don't need "step by step" instructions; you can take a raw 30 minute Will rant and find the "Gold" that belongs in the final cut.

4. You are organized and can handle a high volume workflow (8 total deliverables per week).

title: Account & Driver Partnership Specialist
description:
Hiring Filipino and Philippine-based professionals only!



Wingz, is a leading US rideshare company focused on Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT). 

Visit our website: 



Position: Account & Driver Partnership Specialist

Work Schedule: US Hours (EST)

Employment Set-up: Remote (Independent Contractor)  

Employment Type: Full-Time / Long Term

Salary Range: USD 1,200 - 1,800 / Month

Benefit: PTO and HMO after the 120-day probationary period

Pay-out Frequency: Semi-monthly

Equipment: Self-Provide

Performance Bonus: Starts at approximately USD 300–700 per month on average, with potential for higher earnings based on performance. 



About the role:



As an Account & Driver Partnerships Specialist, you will own the operational health of a specific US market. You'll start by learning that market inside and out, its clients, its drivers, its trip patterns, and from there, you'll wear two hats every day. Both are essential to how Wingz works.



On the client side, you'll act as the dedicated account manager for our partnered NEMT brokers, the organizations that send trip requests for their members. You'll handle daily B2B communication, trip coordination, escalation management, and performance reporting. Your job is to build a strong partnership with each broker and earn their trust until Wingz is their most reliable carrier in the market. That trust matters — it's what causes brokers to route more trips to us. And once they do, you'll own the commitment to make sure every assigned trip gets completed safely and on time.



On the driver side, you'll own the full driver lifecycle in your market, recruitment, onboarding, activation, engagement, and retention. That means walking new drivers through every requirement, procedure, and process so they can confidently join the NEMT industry with Wingz. It means proactively reaching out to inactive drivers and reactivating them. It means being the human point of contact that keeps drivers engaged, earning, and partnered with us long-term — because retention isn't built on incentives, it's built on relationships.



This is a foundational individual-contributor role, by design. You'll start at the rank-and-file level because the path forward at Wingz is clear: Specialist ? Senior Specialist ? Market Lead. We're not hiring for a job; we're hiring for a career, and the people who learn the Wingz foundation now are the leaders we promote into the next phase of growth.



Key Responsibilities:



• Learn your market first. Get to know the clients, the drivers, the trip patterns, and the relationships that make your assigned market work; your fluency here is the foundation for everything else.

• Build strong partnerships with our NEMT broker clients. Show up consistently, communicate clearly, and follow through every time. Your goal is to make Wingz the trusted, reliable carrier in your market, so brokers route more trips to us.

• Commit to trip completion. Once a trip is assigned to Wingz, you own it. Coordinate with drivers, monitor trips in progress, and resolve issues quickly so every member gets to their appointment safely and on time.

• Onboard new drivers into the Wingz partnership. Walk them through every requirement, procedure, and process, documentation, background checks, vehicle readiness, so they can confidently join the NEMT industry as a Wingz partner driver.

• Activate inactive drivers. Make the calls, understand what's holding them back, and get them back on the road.

• Drive partner-driver success. Be the human point of contact our drivers can count on. Build loyalty, prevent churn, and grow retention in your market, because every retained driver is one we don't have to replace.

• Help drivers grow their daily earnings. Where needed, coordinate trip assignments and dispatch so your drivers see consistent, meaningful daily income. Strong earnings are what keep drivers partnered with Wingz long-term.

• Step into adjacent responsibilities as the team scales, operations support, dispatch backup, training new hires, and wherever the business needs you most.

• Bring market-level insights back to the wider Wingz team to inform how we improve.



Qualifications:



• Minimum 2 years of relevant professional experience. Client relations, account management, partner success, leadership or supervisory roles, or experience handling drivers and partners at a US-based, or international transportation, rideshare, logistics, or gig-economy company (Uber, Lyft, DoorDash, Instacart, Rappi, DiDi, Cabify, 99, iFood, PedidosYa, inDrive, Loggi, Bolt, Wolt, or similar). What matters is the underlying skill set, not the exact job title.

• Experience working directly with US-based clients or a US-based company. You're already comfortable with US business culture, US English, and the pace of a US-facing role.

• Strong written and verbal English communication. Clear, professional, and warm, you'll be working with US-based clients and drivers every day.

• Tech-savvy with strong initiative to learn. Quick to pick up new platforms (CRM, dispatch software, reporting tools, AI tools), and ready to step into adjacent tasks so your market never loses 
ntum.

• Available to work US Eastern Standard Time (EST). Shift schedules are set based on market and business needs; flexibility is part of the role.

• Proven remote work experience. You've worked from home effectively before, with minimal supervision, the discipline to manage your own day, and a track record of delivering outcomes without someone over your shoulder.

• Your own reliable computer, stable home internet, and a professional remote workspace. All work-from-home equipment is self-provided.

• Proactive, independent, and ownership-minded. You see what needs to be done and do it. You manage your own day, take initiative without waiting for permission, and treat your market's results as your own.

• Curious, coachable, and dedicated. You want to understand why things work, you apply feedback fast, and you measure your contribution in outcomes delivered, not hours logged.

• Passionate about growth. You're here to grow into leadership, not to coast. You bring the energy and follow-through to earn the next role.

title: Video Editor  —  Short Form for a Female Creator Brand
description:
Video Editor — Short-Form for a Female Creator Brand 



We're hiring a Video Editor to become the right hand of our in-house female creator — someone who turns raw clips into content women actually stop scrolling to watch.



This is not a "cut the clips and ship it" job. We're building a content machine, and we want an editor who's genuinely fired up to grow with us, gets better with every edit, and wants this to be a real home — not a one-month gig.



This role supports:

•	Short-form vertical content (primary)

•	Affiliate marketing & brand-driven content



If you love making content that helps women feel motivated, disciplined, confident, and capable — you're going to love it here.

________________________________________



The Game We're Playing 

We sell products by making content people genuinely want to watch, especially on TikTok Shop. Some of it runs organically as shoppable content; some of it runs as paid ads. Either way, good editing is what makes someone stop, watch, and buy.



It's a volume game. The more strong content we put out, the more we grow — and when we grow, everyone who helped build it grows too. Your edits don't disappear into a void. Think of every post as a seed: plant enough good ones and they turn into real revenue — for the brand, for the company, and for you.



That's the whole point. We win as a team, and we want a teammate who's hungry to win.

________________________________________

What We're Really Looking For (Read This Part Twice) 

Skills can be taught. Drive can't. Before anything else, we want someone who:

•	Is genuinely fired up to make great content — not just clock hours

•	Believes they can produce high-quality work. And if you're not fully there yet — that's okay. We will train you. But you have to want it.

•	Is coachable — takes feedback without ego and applies it to the very next edit

•	Is ready to commit. We pour real time, training, and trust into our editors. So we're looking for someone who will commit back and build something long-term with us — not someone passing through.

________________________________________



What You'll Do 

•	Edit short-form videos in our brand style

•	Turn organized B-roll plans and raw footage into scroll-stopping cuts

•	Organizing files in Google Drive using our folder and naming structure

•	Collaborate in 
 for feedback, revisions, and approvals

•	Keep your project status updated in Airtable as you work

•	Learn our niche and audience — who they are and how they watch

•	Follow our documented workflows and creative standards

•	Apply feedback and get sharper with every single edit



________________________________________



Who We're Looking For 

Required

•	Female editor (to match our brand and audience)

•	Short-form social editing experience

•	Strong storytelling instincts

•	Organized and detail-oriented

•	Reliable communication and availability

•	Comfortable working inside a structured, documented system

•	Fired up, coachable, and ready to commit (see the section above — this matters most)

Huge Plus

•	Experience editing for female creators

•	Familiar with wellness, fitness, or lifestyle niches

•	Experience with affiliate or UGC-style content

•	You genuinely enjoy systems, clarity, and repeatable workflows



________________________________________



Compensation 

We pay hourly, and we keep it simple and fair.

How it works

•	You're paid for the hours you work. Tell us your preferred hourly rate when you apply.

•	Prefer a salary? Once you've proven out, we offer salaried arrangements — and the deal is straightforward: commit to your hours, consistently show up, and we pay your full contracted amount, even on a week you come up a little short. (If hours drop far below what we agreed, pay reflects the hours actually worked. Hit your commitment and you never have to think about it.)

Bonuses & extras

•	We regularly add bonuses and extra pay onto paychecks for strong work. When you make us look good, we take care of you.

•	We run team challenges and incentives — like "we need 100 assets this week, let's go" — with rewards for the crew that delivers. Fast, motivated editors earn more here, not just more hours.

You only ever get paid for real work — and strong, committed editors consistently earn above their base.

Learning & Growth — We Invest In You 

You do not need to be a branded-UGC master on day one. If you're coachable and hungry, we will get you there.

We give you:

•	Real examples of the content we want you to make

•	Creators in our niche we admire, for inspiration

•	Visual references for pacing, captions, and style

•	A clear brief for every single asset

In return, we ask for commitment. The training, the feedback, the systems — that's us investing in you. We're looking for an editor who will take that investment and build a long-term home here.

Growth is expected. Perfection on day one is not.



________________________________________



How We Work (And Why People Stay) 

•	Work on your own time. We care about output and deadlines, not whether you're online 9-to-5. Start with the hours that fit your life and ramp up as you prove out and want more — part-time is a perfectly fine place to begin.

•	A real community. Our team lives in 
 — it's friendly, supportive, and genuinely fun. You're not editing alone in the dark; you've got a crew.

•	Clarity over chaos. Documented workflows, organized files, clear expectations. You're never guessing what to do next.

•	A system that has your back. For B-roll content, our system drafts a plan for each video — the building blocks come organized and ready, so you're never staring at a blank timeline wondering where to start. You get to focus on the craft.

Tools You'll Use (We Teach You — No Stress If You're New) 

•	Google Drive — organized project folders

•	
 — feedback, revisions, approvals

•	Airtable — a friendly editor dashboard where you track your work and pull each video's plan

Every workflow is documented, intuitive, and built to be easy to follow. Never touched these before? We'll teach you.

________________________________________



About Us 

We build and grow creator brands and shoppable content across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube — heavy on lifestyle, wellness, fitness, discipline, and the kind of content that makes women feel motivated and capable.

Our content world:

•	Lifestyle & wellness routines

•	Fitness, discipline, habits, and consistency

•	Creator education & behind-the-scenes business

•	Affiliate marketing (Amazon, TikTok Shop)

•	Brand partnerships, UGC-style deliverables, and paid ads

There's a primary creator you'll edit for, but Creator Studio also produces and manages a wider library of content and assets — so there's always room to grow into more.



________________________________________



How to Apply (Follow This Carefully — It's Our First Test) 

1.	Send 2–3 short-form samples

2.	Tell us:

o	Your availability.

o	Part-time or full-time

o	Your preferred hourly rate

o	Your experience with content creation/video editing

3.	In 2–3 sentences, tell us why you're fired up about this role. We read these.

Two rules:

•	Applications that don't follow these steps won't be reviewed.

•	Include the word "seedling" somewhere in your message, so we know you read all the way to the end.

If you've got the drive and you're ready to commit, we'd genuinely love to meet you. Let's workkk.

title: CPG Product Development Manager | URGENT
description:
Location: Remote (Los Angeles, CA based company) | Type: Full-Time | Experience: 5–10 Years



About the Role:



We're looking for a driven and detail-oriented Product Development Manager with prior experience in CPG, food & beverage, pet, beauty, or consumer packaged goods manufacturing. You'll join our team and serve as the central engine behind new products, product modifications, new size launches, a packaging overhaul and product line management across our portfolio of brands. This is a cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of product, sourcing, and brand — and the right person thrives in both strategic and hands-on environments.



You'll partner closely with our brand teams, business managers, and procurement specialist to take product changes from concept to completion. You'll own the full lifecycle of each project and keep all the moving parts aligned.



What You'll Do:



Product Development & Modification



Lead and execute new products OR product changes across multiple brands — including new sizes, format changes, material updates, modifications, and dimension adjustments

Translate brand and business team requests into clear, actionable product specifications

Proactively identify opportunities for product line extensions or improvements across the portfolio

Review and approve spec sheets, prototypes, and samples to ensure they meet brand and quality standards

Portfolio Knowledge & Product Consistency



Maintain a deep, working knowledge of the full product catalog across brands — understanding what exists, what is in development, and how products relate to each other across sizes and variants

Proactively identify and resolve inconsistencies across the portfolio — for example, if one size of a product carries a benefit or feature that another size does not, you flag it and drive alignment

Audit product lines for discrepancies in specs, sizing, materials,, or benefit claims and develop a plan to bring them into consistency

Partner with project managers and growth managers who own the catalog to ensure product development decisions are grounded in the full picture of what exists

Maintain organized records of product specs, supplier details, and project timelines to support cross-team visibility

Supplier & Procurement Collaboration



Work alongside our procurement specialist to source and qualify suppliers based on product requirements

Hand off supplier relationships once specifications are finalized, while staying engaged through launch to ensure alignment

Evaluate supplier capabilities against technical and brand requirements

Cross-Brand Coordination



Act as the central point of contact between brand teams, business managers, procurement, and operations

Manage multiple projects simultaneously across brands without letting anything fall through the cracks

Communicate project status, timelines, risks, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders

Sometimes you'll lead a project from scratch — other times you'll be handed a request and execute it. You're equally comfortable with both.

What We're Looking For:



Experience & Background



5–10 years of experience in product development, product management, or a closely related role

Background in CPG, food & beverage, pet, beauty, or consumer packaged goods manufacturing

Proven track record managing product changes across multiple brands or product lines simultaneously

Experience working with suppliers and cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment

Skills & Abilities



Technically literate — you can read a spec sheet, understand materials and tolerances, and speak the language of consumer goods manufacturing

Hands-on experience with packaging development — dimensions, materials, structural specs, and print specs are not foreign to you

Strong project management skills — you keep projects on track without micromanaging

Excellent communicator across all levels, from the factory floor to brand leadership

Highly organized with strong attention to detail, especially when managing a large catalog of SKUs

Self-starter who can identify what needs to be done without being told, but also executes well when given direction

Comfortable with ambiguity — you can figure things out as you go

Nice to Have



Prior experience supporting or working within a procurement function

Experience managing private label or multi-brand portfolios

Who You'll Work With



You'll be embedded in a collaborative environment where you interact daily with brand teams, business managers, and our procurement specialist. You won't have direct reports in this role — but you'll have significant influence across the organization. The right person for this role leads through expertise, relationships, and results.



We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.





Application Question(s):

Do you have experience developing or commercializing physical consumer products — such as food, beverage, pet, beauty, or household goods? Yes / No

Have you managed product development across more than one brand or product line at the same time? Yes / No

Are you able to communicate professionally in English, both written and verbal? Our team operates globally and all cross-functional communication is conducted in English.



TO APPLY:

Please send the link of your resume using Google Drive link.

Scaledforce is a Canadian staffing company that helps growing Canadian businesses scale by hiring top-tier remote professionals. We focus on long-term placements, clear KPIs, and strong support so our tea
mbers can build stable, fulfilling and rewarding careers.



About the Client

You will be supporting a marketing and creative agency that produces thoughtful, polished, high-performing creative for technical B2B brands. The client works across professional services, technology, SaaS, and other complex sectors, turning technical ideas into clear, compelling visuals across digital, print, presentation, and web formats.



Job Overview

We are looking for an intermediate-level Graphic Designer who loves design, understands how visuals support business goals, and is excited by new technology and AI-enabled creative workflows. You will create and revise designs for a variety of client projects, balancing strong design standards with client feedback, brand guidelines, accessibility best practices, and campaign objectives.



This role requires you to work on a Mac. All creative is produced in a Mac-based environment, and you must be comfortable in Pages and the broader Apple workflow alongside the rest of the design toolkit. You will work closely with the team in a remote environment to produce creative that is on-brand, on-time, and ready for review, publication, or production.



Work Schedule

•    Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST (12:00 AM – 9:00 AM PHT)

•    Some flexibility on start/end times; core requirement is availability during the client's working hours



Salary & Incentives

Base Salary: PHP 50,000 – 58,000 per month

Performance-based quarterly bonuses



What You'll Design

•    Organic social media imagery

•    Paid social and search ads

•    White papers, ebooks, case studies, and PDF resources

•    PowerPoint decks, templates, and presentation graphics

•    Website landing pages and web page updates

•    Blog feature images, diagrams, photos, and supporting graphics

•    Product sheets, data sheets, and sales enablement collateral

•   
 and newsletter designs — branded layouts, campaign graphics, headers, and supporting visuals

•    Brand guides and visual identity documentation



Key Responsibilities

•    Create and revise designs based on feedback while maintaining design quality, brand consistency, and client expectations

•    Develop fresh, professional visual concepts for technical B2B audiences across multiple channels

•    Produce print-ready and digital-ready assets for campaigns, content, presentations, events, and websites

•    Support advertising campaigns by providing design input and campaign-ready creative

•    Maintain and update client brand guides, ensuring work reflects each brand's values, tone, and visual standards

•    Apply accessibility best practices, including WCAG-informed choices around colour, contrast, legibility, layout, and usability

•    Understand how design choices impact SEO, website performance, load times, and user experience

•    Use AI tools to support creative volume, variation, and exploration while personally auditing and owning final quality

•    Stay current on design trends, tools, platform changes, and creative best practices

•    Maintain clear project documentation, file naming, labelling, and asset organization

•    Complete work on time so teammates have enough time to review, revise, and deliver within client budgets



Qualifications

Required:

•    3+ years of graphic design experience, ideally in marketing, agency, or B2B environments

•    Strong portfolio showing digital, print, presentation, and web design work

•    Comfort working with technical or complex business topics and turning them into clear, engaging visuals

•    Strong attention to detail — layout, hierarchy, typography, consistency, and production quality

•    Ability to take feedback well and revise work thoughtfully

•    Strong communication skills in a fully remote team environment

•    A proactive, tech-forward mindset and interest in emerging tools, AI, and design innovation

•    Strong sense of ownership over quality, timelines, and client-ready work

•    Must work on a Mac and be familiar with Pages

•    Must be familiar with Canva

•    Must be able to design in PowerPoint

•    Must be familiar with Figma

•    Must have experience with generative AI image tools (e.g. Nano Banana or similar)

•    Must be comfortable working with photography and photo editing



Nice to Have:

•    Familiarity with Claude and Claude's suite of services

•    Familiarity with Asana and SharePoint

•    Experience supporting paid ad creative, landing pages, and content marketing campaigns

•    Experience designing for professional services, technology, SaaS, manufacturing, engineering, or other technical B2B sectors



Who Thrives in This Role

•    You are organized, curious, detail-oriented, and comfortable moving between creative thinking and precise execution

•    You bring new ideas to the table while respecting brand guidelines, timelines, budgets, and client expectations

•    You learn new tools fast and stay current with emerging design technology

•    You treat AI as a creative co-worker while owning the final quality yourself

•    You take ownership of quality, timelines, and client-ready work



Work-From-Home Requirements

•    Mac computer required — Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) or an Intel Mac with 16GB RAM minimum; macOS kept current, with Pages installed

•    Internet speed of at least 25 Mbps (upload & download)

•    Noise-cancelling headset

•    Power backup (UPS, generator, or nearby co-working space)

•    Quiet, dedicated home workspace with a desk



Why Join Scaledforce

Benefits & Perks:

•    13th Month Pay

•    SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG

•    HMO Health Insurance

•    Paid Time Off + Sick Leave: 10 PTO days (accrued) + 5 sick days after probation

•    Quarterly performance bonuses

•    Annual salary increases based on performance

•    Netflix subscription reimbursement



Career Growth:

•    Long-term, stable client placement with a growing agency

•    Structured onboarding, coaching, and performance feedback

•    Exposure to a wide range of B2B brands, channels, and creative formats



How to Apply (Important)

Please
 the following to 

•    Updated resume

•    Portfolio or link to recent work

•    Subject line: SF Graphic Designer – [Your Name]

Only candidates who follow the instructions above will be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will undergo:

•    Initial Scaledforce screening (30 min)

•    Skills and portfolio assessment (30 min)

•    Final client interview (30 min)

title: AI Automations Specialist

Requirements

Required Qualifications



Completed degree in any field

Experience building tool-using AI agents that call tools, APIs, or external apps

title: Outbound Sales Representative
description:
Compliance Solutions Occupational Training (CSOT) is a U.S.-based Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) training company helping workers and companies stay safe for more than 30 years.

We provide online, instructor-led, virtual and custom safety training courses and have trained more than 500,000 professionals across America to meet regulatory requirements and return home safe every day.



We're seeking professional, remote outbound Sales Development Representatives (SDR) with extremely good English language skills based in the Philippines to join our team.

In this role, you will make outbound calls to U.S.-based businesses in the construction, manufacturing, environmental and related industries. You will engage decision-makers about their safety training needs, promote upcoming courses, and connect both current customers and prospects  with the right CSOT solutions.

This is a remote contractor position with full-time hours (max 40 hours). You will collaborate daily with our U.S. sales team through chat, CRM tools, and video meetings. 



We offer compensation that includes hourly pay, bonuses and commission that rewards those who are able to represent our company in a positive manner, build relationships and close sales.



Core Responsibilities

•	Make a minimum of 120+ outbound calls per day to U.S. companies to promote our courses and services

•	Speak with decision-makers to discover immediate training needs and long-term safety compliance goals

•	Qualify leads, record notes, and update customer data in the CRM

•	Schedule enrollments or hand off larger prospects to Account Executives

•	Follow CSOT’s outreach scripts, discovery questions, and objection-handling tools

•	Communicate with the team through chat and video meetings during U.S. work hours

•	Submit daily activity and performance reports

•	Provide your own computer, headset, and high-speed internet connection, required for clear calls and consistent 

        performance



Must-Have Requirements

•	Excellent English language skills with an above average English vocabulary.

•	The ability to speak and understand and converse with English speaking professionals on the telephone

•	Ability to work night-time hours to reach clients during U.S. business hours

•	Prior experience closing sales in an individual or call center setting.

•	A recent, reliable computer, quality headset, and stable high-speed internet

•	Experience following scripts, documenting activity, and the ability to communicate in a team environment



Ideal Candidates Will Possess:

•	Excellent English communication skills, both spoken and written

•	Experience selling to U.S.-based business professionals by phone every day

•	Experience in “relationship-based” selling with a strong focus on building trust and rapport with new and existing 

        customers, asking thoughtful discovery questions, and matching customers with the right solution

•	Located in the Philippines with a reliable home office setup

•	At least 1 year of outbound B2B sales or appointment setting

•	Strong work ethic

•	Excellent organizational skills and customer follow-through

•	Proficient using computer software, CRM systems, and communication tools

•	Positive, motivated individual who is goal oriented



Nice to Have

•	Prior experience in safety training, compliance, construction, manufacturing, environmental or related industries



About the Position

This role is best suited for those who enjoy speaking to contact on the telephone in a 100% outbound calling position. You MUST be organized and self-motivated with the ability to stay on track and meet daily, weekly and monthly quotas. The right person will have a strong sense of purpose, be dependable, coachable, speak clearly and understandably on the phone, and be motivated by working in an environment that focuses on results and building client relationships. 



If you’re looking for a career and not just another job, we encourage you to:

1.	Visit our website at: 
 to learn more about us

2.	Send us your resume and a 30-60 second voice recording of you introducing yourself and a short sales presentation. Feel free to pick the product or service of your choice, we’re more interested in how you communicate.

2–3+ years in property management, leasing, or real estate support

Strong English communication, organization, and attention to detail

Be part of a growing remote property management team and gain hands-on experience supporting multiple client portfolios in a structured, professional environment.

description:

(8) What is the highest workload you have personally handled in a single day or in a single week? Please describe it using specific, measurable figures and briefly explain the context of that workload.



(9) Briefly introduce yourself and describe the qualities, experiences, work habits, or achievements you believe genuinely set you apart from other applicants for this role.

Perform
 and chat management and handle client inquiries

title: Billing Support Analyst - Remote
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MP1 Solutions pioneered the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined compliance programs for decades. Built on the foundation of MedPro Disposal, the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company serving 35,000+ providers across 48 states over the past 15 years, MP1 Solutions extends that operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading. We're doing it with a technology-forward approach, actively developing the AI infrastructure that will make this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

The Billing Support Analyst is the financial backbone of MedPro Disposal’s client lifecycle — ensuring every account is billed accurately, every discrepancy is resolved promptly, and every month-end close is executed without gaps. This role is designed for a tenured billing professional who owns their work end-to-end: from new account setup and billing audits to specialty program management and inbox triage, with the precision and autonomy that keeps the organization’s revenue engine running clean. Success means zero billing errors reaching clients, faster resolution cycles, and a finance team that can scale confidently because its foundation is airtight.



Key Responsibilities:

1.  New Customer Set-Up

• Set up new customer accounts in the billing system, ensuring accurate entry of service agreements, contact details, and pricing schedules.

• Process pending business set-up through to completion upon receipt of hauler confirmation.

• Verify account completeness before the first billing cycle to prevent setup-related invoice errors.



2.  Audit Billing / Reconciliation

• Audit billing records for accuracy, identifying discrepancies, missing charges, or data entry errors.

• Reconcile account data between service records and billing entries to maintain clean, reliable account histories.

• Review customer usage data to identify over-allotment occurrences and generate accurate additional charges across service types:

? Third-party hauler over-allotment

? Per container charges

? Pharmaceutical billing

? Hazardous waste billing

? Other applicable service types as assigned



3.  Finance / Mailback Support Tasks

• Provide Level 2 and Level 3 billing support, resolving escalated issues beyond frontline scope.

• Support mailback program billing and related finance tasks as assigned.



4.  Billing Inbox Management

• Monitor the billing inbox daily, triaging and routing incoming requests to the appropriate tea
mber or queue.

• Communicate with internal teams — including Sales, Operations, and Customer Service — to resolve account setup questions and billing discrepancies.



5.  Month-End Close Support

• Assist with month-end close activities including charge posting, invoice review, and reconciliation tasks.

• Pull invoices and account data to support close reporting and ad-hoc management requests within defined turnaround windows.



6.  Specialty Billing Account Support

• Support billing operations for specialty accounts, adhering to each account’s unique invoicing rules, contract terms, and reporting requirements.

• Ensure accuracy and timeliness across specialty program billing cycles, including:

? Premise

? Humana

? Conviva

? Tempus

? Additional specialty accounts as assigned

title: Junior Database Administrator
description:
About Eventful Cloud

Eventful Cloud is a growing SaaS platform purpose-built for the outdoor recreation and equipment rental industry. Our product suite — including Retail Rentals, Event Reservations, GPS Logistics, and Service CRM — powers dealers and operators across the country. Our backend relies heavily on Supabase (PostgreSQL) for data integrity, business logic, and real-time features.



The Role

We are looking for a motivated Junior Database Administrator with hands-on Supabase and PostgreSQL experience to join the Eventful Cloud engineering team. This is a part-time engagement (20 hours/week) for the first six months, with a clear path to full-time employment for the right candidate. You will work closely with our lead developer to design, implement, and maintain the database logic that powers our platform.



Key Responsibilities

Write, optimize, and maintain PostgreSQL functions, stored procedures, and RPCs using PL/pgSQL

Design and implement Supabase database schemas, migrations, and Row Level Security (RLS) policies

Build and tune complex SQL queries, joins, window functions, and CTEs for application and reporting use cases

Collaborate with the development team to translate product requirements into efficient database logic

Monitor query performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement indexing strategies

Maintain documentation for database objects, function signatures, and data flows

Assist in data modeling for new product features and integrations

Participate in code reviews focused on database layer changes



Required Skills & Qualifications

Must-Have Technical Skills

Proficiency with Supabase — including the Supabase client, dashboard, and project configuration

Strong PostgreSQL knowledge: data types, constraints, indexes, triggers, and transactions

Ability to write production-quality PL/pgSQL functions and stored procedures

Experience creating and consuming Supabase RPC endpoints

Solid SQL fundamentals: complex JOINs, aggregations, CTEs, subqueries, and window functions

Understanding of Row Level Security (RLS) policies in Supabase/PostgreSQL

Familiarity with database migrations and version control of schema changes



Nice-to-Have

Exposure to Supabase Edge Functions or Postgres extensions (e.g., pg_cron, pgvector, uuid-ossp)

Experience with Supabase Realtime or storage buckets

Basic familiarity with TypeScript/JavaScript for understanding how the API layer consumes database logic

Aviora is building one of the fastest-growing supplement brands in the DTC space — and paid social is the engine behind it. We're now looking for an elite Meta media buyer to join our in-house team and own the performance of our paid campaigns from day one.

We don't guess. We test, we read data, and we scale what works. If you're the kind of operator who treats every dollar of ad spend as a decision — and can back every decision with numbers — we want to talk.



YOUR MISSION

Your mission is to profitably scale Aviora's customer acquisition through Meta paid social. You will own the full ad account — from campaign architecture and creative testing to budget management and performance reporting — ensuring we are consistently acquiring customers at or below target CAC while scaling spend efficiently.

 and Instagram

Communication & Project Management: Slack &

CAC: Customer acquisition cost at or below target threshold

ROAS: Campaign and account-level return on ad spend targets met consistently

Creative Velocity: New creative tests launched weekly — you move fast and keep the testing pipeline full

Spend Efficiency: Budget allocated and scaled in line with performance, no wasted spend sitting in underperforming ad sets





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Proven experience running and scaling Meta ad accounts for DTC or eCommerce brands — supplement or health/wellness experience is a strong plus

Demonstrated ability to scale budgets profitably — we want to see numbers, not just titles

Deep understanding of Meta campaign structure, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and creative testing methodology

Strong analytical instinct — you read data daily and make decisions from it, not gut feel

An autonomous operator who owns outcomes, communicates proactively, and doesn't need hand-holding

Up to date on iOS privacy changes, Meta's evolving algorithm, and how to navigate attribution in a post-cookie environment





WHY JOIN AVIORA



Performance-Based Rewards: Bonus structure tied directly to account performance — when the numbers hit, you share in the upside

Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world





THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

You prefer to set campaigns and check in weekly. This account needs daily attention, fast iteration, and sharp decision-making. If you're a passive manager, this isn't the right fit.

You struggle when platform rules change overnight. Meta's ad ecosystem shifts constantly — policy updates, algorithm changes, creative fatigue — and you need to adapt without losing 
ntum.

You see media buying as purely a numbers game with no creative involvement. At Aviora, the media buyer and creative team work closely together. You'll need to have strong opinions on what makes an ad perform, not just what makes it spend.

You want a stable, predictable workflow. We are scaling aggressively. Budgets move, priorities shift, and new opportunities need to be acted on fast. If that's stressful rather than energising, this isn't the right environment.
