Position Overview:

The Manager, Billing & Financial Operations is the operational owner of MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions' non-CA financial transaction engine — the function that ensures every invoice goes out accurately, every payment gets applied, every vendor gets paid, and every manifest and billing record is reconciled and audit-ready.



This is a 1st-line management role for a detail-obsessed, process-driven leader who has run billing and collections teams before. You are not just doing the work — you are building the systems, the SOPs, and the team discipline that make the work run without constant supervision. You manage the specialists; you own the numbers; you report up to leadership with clean, confident data.



Key Responsibilities:

Billing Operations & Transaction Processing

• Own end-to-end billing operations — from invoice generation through delivery, dispute resolution, and closed-loop reconciliation across all MedPro and MP1 service lines

• Oversee accurate and timely processing of all financial transactions: vendor payables, service billings, manifest entries, client invoices, and payment applications

• Ensure all billing records align with service agreements, contracts, and pricing structures — identifying and correcting discrepancies before they reach the client or vendor

• Manage the billing cycle calendar: maintain a disciplined, predictable cadence for invoice runs, payment postings, and month-end closes

• Build and enforce quality controls that reduce error rates, prevent duplicate payments, and maintain clean accounts across all transaction types

Collections & Accounts Receivable Management

• Own the collections process: proactively work aging receivables, contact clients with outstanding balances through defined outreach workflows, and escalate chronic non-payers through the appropriate path

• Maintain current and accurate AR aging reports — tracking open balances, days sales outstanding (DSO), and collection trends with weekly reporting to leadership

• Resolve billing disputes and discrepancies with professionalism and speed — balancing firmness in collections with the client relationship standards MedPro and MP1 are built on

• Identify and flag accounts at risk; recommend credit holds, payment plans, or escalation paths in partnership with leadership

• Ensure all collections activity is documented, auditable, and compliant with applicable regulations

Accounts Payable & Vendor Payments

• Manage the accounts payable function — ensure all vendor invoices are received, approved, accurately coded, and paid on schedule

• Maintain the vendor master list; manage vendor relationships for routine billing and payment inquiries

• Reconcile AP aging reports, resolve vendor disputes, and ensure no invoices age beyond terms without documented reason

• Coordinate with internal teams to ensure all expense submissions, manifests, and purchase-related documents are processed accurately and on time

• Support month-end AP close activities: accruals, reconciliations, and documentation for financial reporting

Team Leadership & Performance Management

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of billing specialists, collections specialists, and AP/transaction processors — setting clear expectations, running weekly check-ins, and delivering structured feedback

• Build and maintain the performance scorecard for the team: accuracy rate, turnaround time, DSO, collection rate, and AP aging metrics — with visible accountability at every level

• Design and document SOPs for every process the team touches — billing, collections, AP, manifest processing, and dispute handling. If it is not written down, it does not exist

• Identify skill gaps, cross-training opportunities, and development paths that build team depth and reduce single-point-of-failure risk

• Escalate issues and risks to leadership proactively — full transparency, clean data, solution-first framing

Systems, Reporting & Process Improvement

• Own the financial operations technology stack — CRM billing modules, AP platforms, reporting dashboards — ensuring data integrity and team adoption

• Build and maintain weekly and monthly reporting packages for leadership: transaction volumes, AR aging, DSO, collection performance, billing error rates, and AP status

• Identify inefficiencies in the current billing, collections, and AP workflows and lead process improvement initiatives with measurable impact

• Support system migrations and platform changes as needed — including data mapping, testing, and team training for any new financial operations tools

• Ensure all financial operations are compliant with applicable data privacy, security, and regulatory standards

title: Senior Amazon Brand Manager
description:
The Opportunity

Holiday Traditions is a personalized gift brand that has been selling for over 23 years, with a catalog of 1,500+ SKUs (Many are Parent/Child) across Amazon, ETSY and our own Shopify store.



We are looking for a senior Amazon operator to own the growth and day-to-day running of our Amazon brand, working alongside the lead who runs the channel today, with a clear path to take on more responsibility as the business scales.

This is a real ownership role with real autonomy. If you want to run an Amazon brand, drive its organic growth, and grow into broader ownership of the channel over time, this role is built for you.





What You Will Own

Organic Growth & Ranking



Keyword research, indexation, and ranking across core and new SKUs

Listing optimization for conversion: titles, bullets, images, A+ Content and Brand Story

Recovering and growing organic sessions and rank across the catalog

Catalog & Listings



Detail page integrity, variations, parentage, and flat-file management

New SKU setup and catalog structure

Resolving suppressions and listing issues quickly

Account Health & Operations



Order Defect Rate (ODR), policy and IP issues, and reinstatements

Seller Support case management

FBA inventory execution (shipments, stranded inventory), reimbursements and claims

Returns, buyer messaging, and review/rating monitoring

SKU Economics & Expansion



Recommending SKU-level profitability improvements

Supporting and executing Amazon launches for our new year-round categories (personalized gifts)





What You Will Not Own (Yet)

Pricing, promotions, advertising (managed by our agency), and inventory buying sit with our Amazon lead today.

You will be expected to identify opportunities in these areas and make recommendations, but final decisions currently sit elsewhere.

As you grow into the role, there is a clear path to take on broader ownership of the channel.











A Note on the Catalog

Our catalog is large, with over 1,500 SKUs, but much of that consists of parent / child variations and seasonal ranges. 

Success in this role is not about managing every SKU. It is about identifying and prioritizing the products, categories, and opportunities that drive the greatest commercial impact.





What Success Looks Like

First 90 Days



Develop a deep understanding of the catalog, customer, and account

Audit organic performance and ranking opportunities

Clear outstanding listing and account health issues

Build an organic growth roadmap and prioritization system

First Year



Restore and grow organic rank and sessions on core SKUs

Grow Amazon revenue through organic levers

Keep the account healthy through peak season (ODR under 1%, no unresolved listing issues)

Successfully launch and build organic visibility for new year-round categories





How We Work

We are a founder-led business that runs lean.

We value ownership, initiative, and clear written communication. People here are trusted to take responsibility, solve problems independently, and bring ideas to the table.

We move quickly, support one another, and expect people to challenge the way things are done when they see a better path.



Most importantly we are obsessed with learning. We encourage personal and professional development. 



Peak Season

Holiday Traditions does the majority of its volume during Q4.

Planning for and executing through peak season is a critical part of this role and an important contributor to overall business success.



What You Bring



5+ years managing or growing Amazon Seller Central accounts, ideally for seven-figure or larger brands

A proven track record of improving organic rank and growing revenue, not just maintaining listings

Strong catalog operations skills, including flat files, variations, suppressions, and detail page troubleshooting

Fluency in Amazon data sources such as Business Reports, Brand Analytics, and Search Query Performance

Experience with tools such as Helium 10, Data Dive, or similar

Comfort owning account health and day-to-day Amazon operations

Enough working knowledge of PPC and inventory management to coordinate effectively, even if you do not own those functions initially

A proactive, self-sufficient approach with the confidence to challenge decisions using evidence and data

Excellent written English and experience working in an asynchronous environment

Attitude of continuous improvement and personal development.

Interest in AI. 



Hiring Process



Introductory Call

Paid Test Project (approximately 2–3 hours) with a short Loom walkthrough

In-Depth Interviews

References & Offer

We respect candidates' time and do not ask for free work.





What We Offer



Competitive compensation based on experience

Full-time remote position (offshore candidates welcome)

A genuine ownership role with a clear path toward broader channel leadership

Performance-based bonus opportunities

Ongoing training, development, and growth opportunities

The opportunity to make a meaningful impact within a growing eCommerce business





How to Apply

To help us identify candidates with genuine Amazon ownership experience, please complete the following as part of your application:

1. Start your application with the word "ORNAMENT"

Please answer each question in 150 words or less.

2. Describe one ASIN whose organic rank you personally improved.

What did you change, and what happened to rank and sessions?

3. Describe the largest Amazon account where you owned results (not just executed tasks).

What was the catalog size, approximate revenue, and what were you personally accountable for?

4. Record a short Loom video (approximately 2 minutes).

Choose any Amazon listing that you believe has a clear opportunity for improvement and explain:



What you would change first

Why you would make that change

What impact you would expect it to have

Applications that do not include the above information will not be considered.

title: High-Output Final Cut Pro Video Editor (Luxury Real Estate & Events) – JT Visuals & Four Horsemen Style
description:
Lone Wolf Media is a premium production studio specializing in luxury architectural real estate films and high-end editorial event documentaries. We don't make boring, slow property walkthroughs—we treat real estate like luxury car commercials and events like cinematic movies.



We are heavily inspired by industry leaders like JT Visuals and Four Horsemen Media. We operate a highly optimized, fast-paced pipeline. If you know how to leverage project templates, keyboard shortcuts, and pre-saved presets to deliver lightning-fast, ultra-crispy edits without sacrificing quality, you are the exact editor we are looking for.



This is a long-term, full-time position for a high-efficiency Final Cut Pro rockstar who thrives on speed, execution, and clear communication.



OUR CULTURE & WORK ETHIC:



"Go Until the Job is Done" Tenacity: We are an elite, high-performance team. We do not have a "clock out exactly at 8 hours" mindset. We stay at our desks, miss dinners, and do whatever it takes to execute our projects with extreme excellence.



Extreme Overdelivery: While our baseline requirement is 2 completed videos per shift, we are hunting for top performers who push themselves to deliver 3. If you want a comfortable, casual 9-to-5 where you can coast, this is NOT the studio for you. We only hire the top 1% of talent who treat editing like an elite sport.



CORE PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS:



Daily Output: Ability to comfortably produce 2 fully completed video edits per 8-hour shift by utilizing our optimized workflows, project templates, and pre-built asset libraries.



Strict 24-Hour Turnaround: First drafts for standard short-form real estate and event assets must be delivered within 24 hours of receiving the footage.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:



Premium Real Estate Editing: Crafting fast-paced, addictive walkthroughs utilizing seamless zoom transitions, smooth camera movement, and rhythm-based cuts.



Cinematic Event Storytelling: Editing elegant, multi-cam documentary-style wedding and event films with a heavy focus on continuous audio sync and clean narrative pacing.



S-Log3 Color Grading in FCP: Color grading footage from multiple Sony camera bodies (A7V, A7SIII, FX3) shot uniformly in S-Log3 to achieve gorgeous, natural skin tones.



The "Crispy" Social Export Workflow: Executing specialized export pipelines, including downscaling high-resolution masters and running them through Topaz Video AI to beat platform compression algorithms.



TECHNICAL & SOFTWARE REQUIREMENTS:



Software Ecosystem: Expert-level mastery of Final Cut Pro (FCPX).



Style & Plugins: Deep familiarity with the Ryan Nangle editing style and his ecosystem of plugins (Shake transitions, Motion Blur, Vision Bundle, seamless zooms, etc.).



Hardware Setup: A powerful Apple Silicon editing rig capable of handling heavy 10-bit H.265/HEVC S-Log3 files seamlessly.



Communication: Fast internet speed, instant availability on Slack for real-time team collaboration and daily check-ins, and utilizes Frame.io for smooth revision tracking.



WHAT WE OFFER:



Starting Base Salary: $900 – $1,100 / month (Based on your initial portfolio review).



Fast-Track Runway to $1,600: Clear performance-based milestones to scale your salary up to $1,600 / month as soon as you demonstrate you can consistently hit our 24-hour turnaround deadline, bleed excellence, and maintain our daily production volume with minimal revisions.



Long-Term Stability: A consistent, respect-driven workspace with room to grow alongside the studio.



HOW TO APPLY (DO NOT SKIP):



To filter out automated bot applications, you must follow these instructions exactly, or your application will be instantly deleted:



Start your application message with the exact words: "LONE WOLF CRU".



Provide a direct link to your portfolio or website.



Highlight exactly two videos in your portfolio: Your absolute best real estate edit, and your absolute best wedding or event edit.



Confirm that you understand our "Go Until the Job is Done" culture, meet our 24-hour turnaround deadline, and explain how you optimize your Final Cut Pro workflow for maximum editing speed.

We are seeking an analytical, process-driven Strategic Project Manager to act as the primary gatekeeper and operational architect for our upcoming initiatives. In this role, you will evaluate incoming opportunities in the EV charging station and vehicle inspection spaces, analyzing them against our strategic goals and past performance to determine viability ("Should we pursue this project?").



You won't just manage timelines—you will be responsible for deconstructing complex project scopes, identifying technical and utility requirements, reviewing or creating winning commercial proposals, and designing step-by-step Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). The ideal candidate combines a background in technical project management (infrastructure, utilities, or fleet operations) with a rigorous approach to process standardisation.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Project Evaluation & Feasibility Analysis (Go/No-Go)



Critically evaluate new project leads for charging station installations and vehicle inspection programs to assess financial profitability, technical viability, and operational capacity.



Review prospective station sites or fleet sizes against our historical data to advise leadership on whether a project makes strategic sense to pursue.



Factor in variables like utility grid capacity, local zoning laws, inspection volume, and regional compliance factors during initial evaluation phases.

Map out exact requirements for EV charging deployment (e.g., electrical load demands, transformer upgrades, hardware/software interoperability, ADA compliance).



Identify exact criteria for vehicle inspection setups (e.g., diagnostic tool integration, physical lane layouts, safety testing compliance, data management systems).



Pinpoint project bottlenecks, supply chain constraints (hardware lead times), and permitting risks early on.



3. Proposal Creation & Review



Draft thorough, professional project proposals, Requests for Proposals (RFPs), and Statements of Work (SOWs) for clients, municipal entities, or enterprise fleet partners.



Conduct strict reviews of internally created proposals to ensure cost estimates, deployment timelines, and resource allocations are realistic and protect the company from scope creep.



4. Process Optimization & SOP Development



Build out a library of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for newly approved projects to ensure seamless, highly repeatable field execution.



Author SOPs for charging station installation, site commissioning, safety testing, and post-install maintenance.



Create standardized workflows, inspection checklists, and software training SOPs for vehicle inspection technicians to ensure quality control and regulatory compliance.



Qualifications & Experience:

Experience: 4+ years of project management or operations management experience, specifically within EV charging infrastructure, civil/electrical construction, fleet management, or automotive service/inspection programs.



Analytical Assessment: Strong ability to read technical site plans, utility sheets, or fleet specifications and make data-driven decisions on project feasibility.



Documentation Excellence: Proven track record of drafting complex proposals, SOWs, and creating highly structured, clear SOPs for technical workflows.



Regulatory/Technical Knowledge: * Familiarity with EV charging infrastructure (Level 2 & DC Fast Charging, utility interconnection, permitting).



Familiarity with automotive/vehicle inspection standards, diagnostic equipment, or compliance regulations is a major asset.



Tools: Proficiency with project management platforms (e.g., ClickUp, Asana, Jira, Monday.com) and visual process mapping tools (e.g., Lucidchart, Miro).



Certification: PMP, Lean Six Sigma (Green or Black Belt), or CAPM is highly preferred.



Who You Are:

The Strategic Gatekeeper: You know how to look past the excitement of a new deal and evaluate whether it actually makes financial and operational sense for the team to execute.



Detail-Obsessed: You care about the nuance of a utility grid connection or the exact calibration steps of a vehicle inspection tool, ensuring no detail is missed in the scope.



A Process Creator: You thrive on turning a chaotic, "one-off" project execution into a repeatable, step-by-step SOP system that anyone on the team can follow.



An Effective Communicator: You can easily align utility companies, electrical contractors, inspection technicians, and executive stakeholders on a singular vision.

title: Demand Planning |URGENT
description:
PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING:

This role requires fixed US business hours: 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM PST (11:30 PM – 7:30 AM PHT), Monday through Friday. There is no schedule flexibility. Please confirm you can commit before applying — applications that do not acknowledge this will not be reviewed.





ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are a fast-growing consumer products company selling direct-to-consumer and through retail channels. This is a newly created role — the first dedicated demand planning hire on the team.



You will own the forecast: translating sales data, channel trends, promotional activity, and launch signals into accurate demand projections that drive purchasing decisions. You are not here to maintain a model someone else built — you are here to build it, own it, and make sure it is never wrong twice for the same reason.



Our stockout problem is real and recurring. The person in this role is the early warning system that prevents inventory failures before they happen — and the analytical engine behind every reorder decision.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN:

Build and maintain rolling demand forecasts by SKU using sales history, channel velocity, seasonality, and trend signals

Monitor daily sales across all channels and flag anomalies — spikes, slowdowns, unusual patterns — before they become inventory problems

Translate forecasts into purchasing recommendations and reorder timing for the procurement team

Set and maintain safety stock levels and reorder points across the full product catalog

Track actual vs. forecasted demand weekly and recalibrate — do not let the model go stale

Identify demand signals early: viral activity, promotional lifts, new channel launches, and SKU lifecycle changes

Partner with marketing on upcoming campaigns and build inventory plans before they go live

Support new product launches with initial stocking models and sell-through tracking

Flag slow-moving and excess inventory before it becomes a write-off

Factor supplier lead time variability into forward planning and communicate risks proactively

Deliver a weekly demand and inventory health report to leadership — clear, specific, and actionable



HOW THIS ROLE CONNECTS:

You will work closely with our Procurement Specialist — your forecast drives their purchasing decisions. You cross-check each other's numbers, and if they diverge, you work it out before an order goes in.

You will also work in Finale Inventory daily. Clean, current data is the foundation of everything you do — if the numbers are wrong, your job is to catch it and escalate immediately.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

4–6 years of experience in demand planning, supply chain, or inventory management

Proven track record owning a demand forecast end-to-end — not just maintaining one someone else built

Advanced Excel — you build your own models, run scenario analysis, and know when a number is wrong

Experience with an inventory management system or ERP

Strong written English — this is async-first and your analysis must speak for itself

Comfortable making calls with imperfect data and documenting your assumptions clearly

2+ years working remotely for a US-based or global company

Available to work 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM PST (11:30 PM – 7:30 AM PHT), Monday–Friday — non-negotiable



NICE TO HAVE:

Background in e-commerce, consumer goods, or multi-channel retail

Experience with promotional and launch demand modeling — not just steady-state forecasting

Familiarity with planning tools such as Streamline, Lokad, or NetSuite

Experience supporting a procurement team with purchasing recommendations, not just producing a forecast in isolation



HOW YOU'LL WORK

Fully remote, async-first. Written communication is the default — you document assumptions, maintain shared models, and keep the team informed without relying on calls.

You report to the Senior Operations Manager with a weekly async check-in. Your weekly report should be thorough enough that leadership does not need to ask follow-up questions.





WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN 90 DAYS:

A working demand forecast is live for all active SKUs — built by you, documented, and shared with the team

Safety stock levels and reorder points reviewed and updated across the full catalog

Actual vs. forecast variance tracked weekly with clear explanations for any deviation

At least one demand risk identified and acted on before it caused a stockout or overstock

The procurement team is using your output as the primary input for every purchasing decision

Leadership has real-time visibility into forward demand and inventory exposure — no surprises



A NOTE ON THIS HIRE:

We have had stockouts — more than once. This hire is not a backfill. It is a solution to a problem that has held us back. We are looking for someone who takes that seriously: someone who checks the numbers daily not because they are told to, but because they know what happens when no one does.



HOW TO APPLY:

Submit your resume via Google Drive link. In your message, briefly confirm that you can commit to the required schedule: 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM PST (11:30 PM – 7:30 AM PHT), Monday through Friday.



Applications that do not confirm schedule availability will not be reviewed.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
About Scaledforce

Scaledforce is a Canadian staffing company that helps growing Canadian businesses scale by hiring top-tier remote professionals. We focus on long-term placements, clear KPIs, and strong support so our tea
mbers can build stable, fulfilling and rewarding careers.



About the Client

You will support the COO of a fast-growing start up based in Canada that provides premium technology products to universities, healthcare centers, and large corporations across North America. With roughly 100 clients, 95% of the customer base in the US, and expansion into the UK underway, the company is scaling quickly into its next phase of growth.



The COO has been heads-down building the business from day one — wearing every hat, handling every
, and managing every renewal. That’s no longer sustainable. He needs a sharp, reliable operator to take day-to-day admin off his plate so he can shift his focus to strategy and growth. This is not a corporate environment — it’s a lean, scrappy team that moves fast and rewards people who take ownership.



Job Overview

We are looking for a part-time, remote Executive Assistant who will own the COO’s inbox, manage client renewal administration, coordinate with the external bookkeeping team, and help build the SOPs that don’t exist yet. You will also support recruiting operations, website content, and other operational tasks as the business grows.



This is not a “sit and wait for instructions” role. You will be expected to learn fast, triage independently, and take ownership of your lanes from week one. The right person treats every task — whether it’s chasing a university procurement form or drafting an
 in the COO’s voice — with equal precision and urgency.



Work Schedule

•      Monday to Friday

•      10:00 AM – 7:00 PM EST (Eastern Standard Time)

•      Philippine Time: approximately 10:00 PM – 7:00 AM PHT



Salary & Incentives

Base Salary: PHP ?36,000 – ?42,000 per month

Quarterly Bonuses: Performance-based quarterly bonuses



Key Responsibilities

 & Calendar Management

•      Manage and organize the COO’s inbox daily (G Suite) — triage, categorize, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks

•      Draft
 replies that match the COO’s voice and tone; send independently once trust is established

•      Schedule and coordinate meetings across time zones

•      Prepare a daily brief before the COO starts his day — who he’s meeting, why, and what the goal is for each conversation



Renewal & Procurement Administration

•      Track client renewals via HubSpot and internal spreadsheets

•      Follow up on invoices sent through QuickBooks (issued 3 months in advance)

•      Navigate university and corporate procurement systems, vendor registration portals, and contracting workflows

•      Route signature requests and flag legal or tax clauses for COO review

•      Handle check image management and reconciliation with the external bookkeeper



Light Bookkeeping & AP Support

•      Coordinate with the external bookkeeping service on escalations

•      Assist with cross-border (Canada–US) wire transfer verification and documentation

•      Respond to accounts payable inquiries from client finance teams



Lead Generation & CRM Management

•      Build targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn, AI research tools, and other sources

•      Enrich contact data and log prospects into HubSpot with accurate tagging and notes

•      Maintain CRM hygiene — update deal stages, flag stalled opportunities, and ensure pipeline data stays current

•      Prepare pre-call briefs and post-call follow-up
s fro
eting notes



LinkedIn Content & Social Media

•      Draft and schedule LinkedIn posts on behalf of leadership — thought leadership, industry insights, and company updates

•      Monitor and engage with comments, messages, and relevant conversations on LinkedIn

•      Repurpose internal insights and call takeaways into social content



Website Content & SEO

•      Write and publish blog posts and website content on Webflow

•      Support on-page SEO optimization (meta titles, descriptions, internal linking)

•      Research keywords and content topics relevant to the business

General Admin & SOP Building

•      Document and build SOPs for recurring processes (especially the renewal lifecycle) — this is greenfield work and critical to scaling the business

•      Handle personal admin tasks as needed (reservations, appointments, personal scheduling

•      Support workflow improvements and identify opportunities for automation over time

•      Assist with additional operational tasks as the business grows



Qualifications

Required:

•      At least 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant or Virtual Assistant supporting a US or Canadian founder, CEO, or senior executive

•      Strong written English — you will draft professional
s, client correspondence, and content daily

•      Proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets)

•      Proven ability to manage someone else’s
 inbox and calendar with discretion and good judgment

•      Experience with procurement, renewals, invoicing, or accounts payable processes

•      Experience with HubSpot (CRM) — navigating contacts, deals, and logging activities

•      Proactive mindset — you anticipate needs, spot problems before they escalate, and take initiative without waiting to be asked

•      High degree of discretion and confidentiality

•      Reliable internet connection and a dedicated, quiet workspace



Nice to Have:

•      Experience building lead lists and managing prospect data in a CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, or similar), including contact enrichment and pipeline hygiene

•      Experience creating and scheduling LinkedIn content or managing social media accounts on behalf of a founder or executive, including community engagement

•      Experience writing blog posts or website content and working with Webflow or a similar CMS platform, including basic on-page SEO optimization

•      Experience preparing sales proposals, pitch decks, or client-facing collateral from templates or call notes

•      Familiarity with QuickBooks or similar invoicing/bookkeeping tools

•      Familiarity with AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) and a willingness to incorporate them into daily workflows

•      Background working in SaaS, technology, staffing, or agency environments

•      Exposure to cross-border (US/Canada) payment workflows



Who Thrives in This Role

•      You love being the person who keeps everything running — you get genuine satisfaction from creating order out of complexity

•      You’re resourceful and scrappy — this is a bootstrapped company, not a big corporate environment, and you thrive in that kind of setting

•      You learn new tools and systems fast — one walkthrough and you’re running

•      You communicate clearly and concisely — you summarize, you don’t ramble

•      You’re comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and course-correcting as you learn

•      You take ownership — when something is in your lane, you run it without being micromanaged

•      You’re patient with legacy systems (universities still send checks) and energized by building processes from scratch where SOPs don’t exist yet

•      You understand that “80% done by someone else is 100% awesome” — speed and action matter more than perfection



Work-From-Home Requirements

•      Laptop or PC with Intel i5 (or equivalent) or better

•      Internet speed of at least 25 Mbps (upload & download)

•      Noise-cancelling headset

•      Power backup (UPS, generator, or nearby co-working space)

•      Quiet, dedicated home workspace with a desk



Why Join Scaledforce

Benefits & Perks:

•      13th Month Pay

•      SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG

•      HMO Health Insurance

•      Paid Time Off + Sick Leave: 10 PTO days (accrued) + 5 sick days after probation

•      Quarterly performance bonuses

•      Annual salary increases based on performance

•      Netflix subscription reimbursement



How to Apply (Important)

Please
 the following to

*Only candidates who follow the instructions above will be considered

title: Paid Ads Creative Designer (Static + Video)
description:
About Us

We’re a fast-growing US-based media company offering unique subscription services, cutting-edge entertainment, and a range of consumer products. Our paid media operation runs across multiple platforms and we’re scaling our creative output fast. We test constantly, iterate on data, and push volume — and we need someone who thrives in that environment.

This is a fully remote, work-at-your-own-time role. Work is assigned via Wrike, so you control your hours as long as you hit turnaround deadlines.



About the Role

This is not a social media content role. This is not a branding role. This is a performance-driven creative role focused on building high-converting paid ads across Meta, YouTube, TikTok, Snapchat, Google Display, X, Reddit, and CTV.



You will work closely with our creative strategists and media buyers to take concepts from brief to finished asset, fast and at volume. Your work will run, get tested, and directly impact revenue. If you have never created ads that have generated measurable results, this role is not for you.



What You’ll Do

Design high-performing static ad creatives optimized for paid media campaigns.

Edit short-form video ads including hook-driven cuts, UGC-style edits, talking head formats, and motion graphics

Produce high output consistently, targeting 10–15 original static creatives and 5–8 video ads per week

Create multiple variations and adapt each asset to platform-specific placements and specs

Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and creative feedback

Collaborate with strategists on creative concepts aligned with campaign goals and audience psychology

Maintain an organized asset library and deliver clean, well-labeled source files

Stay current on platform trends, competitor creative, and emerging ad formats



What We’re Looking For:



Must Have

Proven experience creating paid ad creatives that have delivered measurable results (Hook Rate, View Rate, CTR, CVR, ROAS)

Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects for video editing

Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator for static design

Strong portfolio of static and video ad creatives, ideally across multiple platforms and DTC or e-commerce brands

Solid understanding of direct response principles: hooks, scroll-stopping visuals, CTA structure

Ability to work at high volume without sacrificing quality

Strong written English, clear communicator, and reliable in a remote async environment



Nice to Have

CapCut or Canva as supplementary tools in your workflow

Experience with AI video tools (e.g. Higgsfield, Runway, or similar)

Prior experience in a performance agency or fast-paced in-house creative team

Familiarity with creative testing frameworks and iteration based on live data



This Role Is For You If

You love making things and can put out quality work consistently

You think in terms of CTR, hooks, thumb-stops, and conversion, not just aesthetics

You’re hungry to grow and want your work to run on real budgets and move real numbers

You want to be part of a creative operation that’s scaling fast



This Role Is NOT For You If

You only work in Canva or CapCut and don’t have Adobe Suite experience

You’ve only created organic social content and have never worked on paid campaigns

You rely on templates and can’t produce original concepts from a brief

You’ve never worked on campaigns with real budgets and measurable KPIs

You need significant creative direction rather than executing independently



How We Work

Work is assigned and tracked via Wrike tickets, you manage your own schedule around deadlines

Creative briefs provided for each concept with clear direction and references

Feedback loop focused on performance improvement, not just visual polish

Data-driven mindset, you’ll be expected to understand and respond to what’s working and iterate on what's not working



To Apply

Send your resume, portfolio, and a short introduction. We want to see examples of paid ad creatives you’ve made, both static and video. If you have performance data to go with them, even better. Show us you understand what makes an ad convert, not just look good.

The ideal candidate will be able to make good decisions independently and will serve as a key part of our strategic vision. In this role you will be responsible for overseeing, implementing and managing the tactical day to day operations of the Holiday Traditions brand.

Beyond your experience, we are also looking for someone who is professional, as well as someone who is self-driven, interested in problem solving, has a diverse range of tasks, and who will become a valuable asset to our great team.

But we admit we’re not for everyone. We’re successful because we have high standards, work hard, and hire smart people with strong critical thinking skills – people who are honest and confident enough to say “I don’t know – BUT I’ll find out!” People whose burning questions during interviews include “How many sick and vacation days do I get?” need not apply. ROLE

To own several key account management metrics and have a direct and visible impact on the long-term success of the business. The primary function of the Brand Manager is to ensure the overall success of the company’s products on Amazon. This includes ensuring the best products for the brand are sourced with defensibility in mind, launching those products effectively, and maintaining a minimum level of profitability per product.

The Brand Manager will oversee every area of product success on Amazon, identify solutions or improvements, and coordinate with multiple team members to see goals are met.

The role oversees key areas of the business that must be maintained on a daily basis in order for the company to stay in business. This includes Customer Experience, Platform Management, Inventory Management, Account Health, etc. But it's not just about hitting targets, it's about the journey and the impact you will have on the company.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Brand Management

Oversee all Amazon account operations on a daily basis

Oversee day to day SKU optimization, PPC optimization, product R&D, and product sourcing yourself or through managing your team

Create and/or review daily and weekly reports and KPIs with other team members for inventory, traffic and sales data and product trends

Check account performance against projections then prepare and execute corrective or proactive actions

Make optimization adjustments to listings in front end and back end

Coordinating with Leadership on budget, new product concepts, and the future product pipeline of the brand

Stay up to date with all the most cutting edge technologies and methods

Meet via Zoom with team members weekly to discuss previous weeks and future plans

Develop a growth strategy in collaboration with Leadership and reverse engineer the tasks that will need executing to achieve this growth

Coordinate with the team to ensure projects are run efficiently for the desired result.

Ensure repeatable processes are being utilized in each area mentioned so that new team members can be onboarded as needed

Analyze Amazon ASIN level data (sales, conversation rate, page views, costs, etc.) to determine why certain products are trending up or down, clearly articulate observations and propose strategies to troubleshoot problems

Develop strategies to increase sales, reduce costs and drive conversion rate of acquired products including: keyword optimization, price optimization, PPC, packaging/inserts, coupons and deals, customer communications, creative, changing package dimensions, removing unprofitable products

Work directly with the PPC Manager to ensure the latest and most effective strategies are being used to launch new products and maintain profitability on existing products

Monitor and resolve communication from Amazon via seller support
s/calls, seller performance notifications, Brand Health platform and any other area where Amazon may leave feedback on our account

RESULTS

All products are hitting KPI's for revenue and profit

New products are launched cost-efficiently and hitting their launch targets

within a reasonable time frame
